schema_note: v2.0 outcome-level failure-mode library from the red-team review. Machine-readable companion of proposal.md section '红队检视：反对意见、失败模式与早期预警'. Complements risk.json (compliance/material risks) with outcome-level failure risks; every triggered warning feeds into the 90-day public review under the Switchback Protocol.
measurement_discipline_zh: 全部预警指标为建议口径，当前无实测基线；试点启动后按 P1—P5 同等测量纪律执行，失败样本不删除。
measurement_discipline_en: All early-warning indicators are proposed definitions with no measured baseline; executed under the same discipline as P1-P5 once pilots launch, with failed samples never dropped.

failure_modes.failure_mode_zh: 主线贯通中断，断点长期存续
failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_zh: 贯通率低于 100% 且断点存续超两个季度
failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_en: Through-rate below 100% with a break persisting over two quarters
failure_modes.response_pathway_zh: 对应段转黄色受控状态，90 天复审四选一处置
failure_modes.response_pathway_en: Segment switched to yellow controlled state; 90-day review four-option disposition

failure_modes.failure_mode_zh: AI 场景停用或名存实亡
failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_zh: 场景连续两季度无公开运行记录
failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_en: A scenario with no public operating record for two consecutive quarters
failure_modes.response_pathway_zh: 折返协议红色状态，启动折返留痕
failure_modes.response_pathway_en: Switchback Protocol red state; switchback archiving starts

failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_zh: P2 等价路径可达率未达标点位存续超一季度
failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_en: P2 non-compliant points persisting over one quarter
failure_modes.response_pathway_zh: SEB 节点字段整改，纳入复审台账
failure_modes.response_pathway_en: SEB node field rectification, entered into the review ledger

failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_zh: 商户保留率趋势持续下行（阈值待基线后核定）
failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_en: Tenant-retention trend declining continuously (threshold set after baseline)
failure_modes.response_pathway_zh: 大钟寺项目触发冲突协商二级流程
failure_modes.response_pathway_en: Dazhongsi project triggers tier-2 conflict negotiation

failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_zh: 年度活动缺席或场景开放清单未按期发布
failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_en: An annual event missed or the open-scenario list not published on schedule
failure_modes.response_pathway_zh: 运营主体复审问责环节专项说明
failure_modes.response_pathway_en: Operator explains in the review-accountability link

failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_zh: 90 天公开复审连续两次无公众参与且无整改闭环
failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_en: Two consecutive 90-day reviews with no public participation and no rectification loop
failure_modes.response_pathway_zh: 参与阶梯回退至共同设计环节补强
failure_modes.response_pathway_en: Participation ladder falls back to the co-design rung for reinforcement

failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_zh: P3 投诉响应中位时长连续两季度劣化
failure_modes.early_warning_indicator_en: P3 median response time worsening for two consecutive quarters
failure_modes.response_pathway_zh: 运行监督环节限期整改并公开
failure_modes.response_pathway_en: Supervision link imposes a deadline for published rectification

cross_reference_zh: risk.json 登记合规与资料风险（八维矩阵）；本库登记结果层失败风险，二者机器可读互引。
cross_reference_en: risk.json registers compliance and material risks (eight-dimension matrix); this library registers outcome-level failure risks; the two cross-reference each other.
boundary_zh: 全部为概念建议；列出失败模式不代表其必然发生；处置路径以 90 天公开复审与折返协议条款为准。
boundary_en: All conceptual proposals; listing a failure mode does not assert it will occur; dispositions follow the 90-day public review and Switchback Protocol terms.
